targets.rawSql:
select
  date_trunc('day', f.created_at) as "time",
  count(*)::numeric as "Receipts/day"
from mart.fact_ib_receipt f
where $__timeFilter(f.created_at)
  and f.warehouse_key in (${warehouse:csv})
  and f.client_key in (${client:csv})
group by 1
order by 1;

select
  date_trunc('day', f.created_at) as "time",
  avg(f.cycle_time_minutes)::numeric as "Avg cycle time (min)"
from mart.fact_ib_receipt f
where $__timeFilter(f.created_at)
  and f.cycle_time_minutes is not null
  and f.warehouse_key in (${warehouse:csv})
  and f.client_key in (${client:csv})
group by 1
order by 1;

select
  date_trunc('day', f.created_at) as "time",
  percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by f.cycle_time_minutes)::numeric as "P95 cycle time (min)"
from mart.fact_ib_receipt f
where $__timeFilter(f.created_at)
  and f.cycle_time_minutes is not null
  and f.warehouse_key in (${warehouse:csv})
  and f.client_key in (${client:csv})
group by 1
order by 1;

panels.title: Receipts + Avg/P95 Cycle Time by Day

targets.rawSql:
select
  w.warehouse_id as warehouse,
  avg(f.cycle_time_minutes)::numeric as avg_cycle_time_min
from mart.fact_ib_receipt f
left join mart.dim_warehouse w on w.warehouse_key = f.warehouse_key
where $__timeFilter(f.created_at)
  and f.cycle_time_minutes is not null
  and f.warehouse_key in (${warehouse:csv})
  and f.client_key in (${client:csv})
group by 1
order by 2 desc;

select
  f.cycle_time_minutes as cycle_time_minutes
from mart.fact_ib_receipt f
where $__timeFilter(f.created_at)
  and f.cycle_time_minutes is not null
  and f.warehouse_key in (${warehouse:csv})
  and f.client_key in (${client:csv});

select
  f.receipt_id,
  f.po_code,
  w.warehouse_id,
  c.client_id,
  f.status,
  f.created_at,
  round(extract(epoch from (now() - f.created_at)) / 3600.0, 2) as age_hours
from mart.fact_ib_receipt f
left join mart.dim_warehouse w on w.warehouse_key = f.warehouse_key
left join mart.dim_client c on c.client_key = f.client_key
where upper(coalesce(f.status,'')) not in ('FINISHED','CANCELLED')
  and f.created_at is not null
  and f.warehouse_key in (${warehouse:csv})
  and f.client_key in (${client:csv})
order by age_hours desc
limit 100;
